description: Seen live on 28 Sep: a VM start (info) followed within a minute by guest-agent errors, and later a scheduled stop (info). The start becomes context on the errors' case; the scheduled stop, related to nothing open, opens no incident. Spec: correlation 'deduplicates noise'; the pain point is disconnected pages.
checks: M2: info-level events never open an incident on their own; they attach as context to a related case
